findings.suggested_fix: Render the body S-3 criteria in the same Given/When/Then wording as the frontmatter.
findings.text: In the markdown body, S-3 AC1-AC5 are shortened to plain statements. They drop the Given/When/Then form used in the frontmatter, so the two copies of the same criteria differ.

findings.suggested_fix: Either keep S-3 as an explicit regression story and say why it is grouped, or split it by constraint.
findings.text: S-3 bundles four separate no-regression outcomes (paging, sort, search, Next appointment column) into one story, so it is not one outcome per story.

rubric_items.reason: All 11 known REQs (REQ-1 to REQ-11) are traced by at least one story. The intent has no assumed REQs.
S-1, S-2 and S-4 each deliver one outcome. S-3 bundles four separate no-regression constraints (paging, sort, search, Next appointment) into one story.
Every frontmatter criterion is Given/When/Then and checkable. The body versions of S-3 AC1-AC5 are shortened to plain statements without Given/When/Then.
Every value in the criteria comes from the intent: 20 per page, Asia/Kolkata, "-", the Last visit title, the Next appointment format, and the status names.
Terms are clear and match the glossary. But the body and the frontmatter word S-3's criteria differently, so the two copies of the same criteria are not consistent.
